annotation.authors_or_issuer: Nemzeti Fejlesztési Minisztérium (Hungarian Ministry of National Development)
key_provisions_or_claims: Developers of autonomous test vehicles must notify and be registered with the transport minister; registration requires ISO 26262 compliance or certification.
A test driver must be in the vehicle and able to take over control immediately, and remains responsible for safe operation.
Mandatory full liability insurance, data recorders (72-hour retention, longer after accidents), and six-monthly reporting.
Testing must progress through simulation, test bench and closed track before public roads; cybersecurity requirements apply.
Vehicle development levels 0-5 are defined, with the developer bearing operating responsibility.
annotation.summary_en: Hungarian ministerial decree 11/2017 (IV.12.) amending road vehicle inspection and registration rules to allow testing of development-purpose autonomous vehicles on public roads. It sets developer registration, ISO 26262 safety requirements, test-driver qualifications, data recording, insurance, cybersecurity, reporting, and automation levels 0-5.
